byte_verification: Each retrieved raw file matched its Git blob SHA-1 at the recorded commit
findings: Reference source is Python 2 and assumes Caffe/AlexNet, 1000 classes and ten image crops.
Weibull upper-tail fitting uses libMR, default tail size20; recalibration defaults alpha rank10 and eucos distance.
OpenMax returns K+1 scores including Unknown; needs a trained neural activation representation, not RF probabilities.
Root copyright has a three-clause BSD-style notice, while bundled libMR has a separate restrictive historical source agreement. Current libMR source/license and numerical equivalence not yet audited.
IDS neural architecture, training protocol, distance normalization, small-class alpha rank and validation tuning contract remain unresolved.
